title: Stripe two-tone heading
description: Light-weight heading in two tones: a dark lead sentence followed inline by a softer slate sentence. Five sizes from card titles to the hero statement.
notes: set at weight 300: pick a typeface with a real light weight
name: stripe-heading

props.name: rest
props.description: the softer sentence that follows the lead on the same line; leave out for a one-tone heading

props.name: stacked
props.description: put the rest on its own line instead of running on after the lead
